_comment: Production registration for the U.S. reference families. Two are admitted under the owner's standing
metadata-only approval of 2026-10-15: the U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission (USCC)
press-release listing and the U.S. Department of the Treasury press-release listing. The third,
us_uscc_press_en, was activated by the founder on 2026-11-22 (DECISION_LOG.md).
These are MANUAL sources: public Daily never fetches uscc.gov or home.treasury.gov. The isolated
shadow collectors preserve dated listing observations on their own branches; the governed admission
(scripts/admit_uscc_official_metadata.py, scripts/admit_us_treasury_official_metadata.py) admits only
official URL, date and issuer metadata into the existing isolated tables. Through these two metadata
sources no headline, body, attachment, translation, summary or topical claim enters the public corpus.
U.S. Pacific Command (the desk's declared scope) stays access-blocked and unregistered; the
separate DVIDS shadow draft stays under shadow/us_indopacom/. The Commerce BIS family is not
registered here because its release is bound to an authenticated scheduled-run attestation that
Daily cannot reproduce (docs/desks/MIGRATION.md).
The USCC press-release narrative family (us_uscc_press_en) is also MANUAL: public Daily never
fetches uscc.gov. Its text is collected privately; the shared Daily lane admits only signed official
links and separately written, USCC-attributed machine explanations of at most 90 words
(core/uscc_press_links.py, core/daily_sources.py). Quotations, linked reports, testimony,
attachments, PDFs and media are excluded. The two metadata sources above are unchanged.
Registering the sources here gives them the same registry row, run-result row and liveness
disposition as every other production source. It enables no fetch.

Dossier-issuer institutions (press_usni, press_navalnews, press_portnews) are registered only as issuers of Living Dossier external sources under the owner decision of 2026-11-14 (DECISION_LOG.md). They have no sources here: nothing is fetched, collected or admitted for them, and they change neither the desk's status nor its public institution count.
